  COMMITTEE AGENDA
  TUESDAY, OCTOBER 13, 2026

  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 1:30 PM

Megan Kerr, Vice Chair
Kristina Duggan, Member

  Members of the public have the option to submit online public comments and email

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-56405  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Intergovernmental Affairs
  Committee meeting of Tuesday, February 10, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-56406  Recommendation to receive and file a staff presentation on Propositions 1 and 43
  and consider recommending support, opposition, or no position to the City Council.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.
